Mawsynram in Meghalaya is often listed as one of the wettest inhabited places on Earth.

content.about: India fills most of South Asia, running from the snowy Himalayas in the north to tropical beaches in the south, and includes the Andaman, Nicobar and Lakshadweep islands. It is the world's most populous country, home to ancient temples, the Taj Mahal and hundreds of languages. Its food, festivals like Diwali and Holi, and film industry are loved worldwide. Tigers, elephants and snow leopards all live within its borders.

standout.text: The Statue of Unity in Gujarat, 182 m tall, is the world's tallest statue.
